content.note: 用于朝说话者或指定地点移动。

examples.english: Can you come to the meeting?

content.note: 组合决定意思；get here 表示到这里。

examples.english: Where can I get a ticket?
How do I get to the station?
Can you give me your number?
Can you give me a hand with this bag?

examples.english: Can you give me an example?

variants.label: 给我你的号码
variants.english: Can you give me your number?

content.note: 用于离开或去其他地方。

examples.english: I go to work by bus.
We can go out after lunch.
I need to go back to the hotel.

variants.label: 去上班
variants.english: I go to work by bus.

content.note: let 后接人，再接动词原形。

examples.english: Please let me know the time.
Let us go to the station.

content.note: 先学习制作含义，再扩展使某物变化。

examples.english: I want to make a reservation.
I need time to make a choice.
It is easy to make a mistake.

content.note: 通常需要说明放置的位置。

examples.english: Put it on the table, please.
Please put it in the bag.
Please put the price in writing.
